people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?
translations.bsb: So the Israelite foremen went and appealed to Pharaoh: “Why are you treating your servants this way?
translations.kjv: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
translations.asv: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
